Title: Sancti Aurelii Augustini Hipponensis episcopi Opera omnia, Tomus Secundus (Patrologiae Latinae Tomus XXXIII): Epistolae, in the four classes of the Maurist edition, with the Appendix of letters falsely attributed
Creator: Augustine of Hippo; edition of the Benedictine monks of the Congregation of St-Maur, "emendata et auctior", superintended by J.-P. Migne
Publisher: Paris: J.-P. Migne, editor ("Excudebatur et venit apud J.-P. Migne editorem"), Patrologiae Cursus Completus, Series Latina, Vol. 33
Publication Date: 1861 (printed at file lines 101 and 157)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1861)
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item bub_gb_nY6mrtKeQUoC (a Google Books scan), full text at https://archive.org/download/bub_gb_nY6mrtKeQUoC/bub_gb_nY6mrtKeQUoC_djvu.txt. Fetched and opened directly 2026-09-30 by the lpc library sweep (second pass); the byte count of the downloaded file (4,236,328) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt. Title page ("PATROLOGIAE LATINAE TOMUS XXXIII", "S. AURELIUS AUGUSTINUS", "Opera omnia post Lovaniensium theologorum recensionem castigata ... studio monachorum ordinis Sancti Benedicti e Congregatione S. Mauri", the Migne imprint and "1861") at file lines 90-157; the volume's "Elenchus" at file lines 166-191; the closing "FINIS TOMI SECUNDI" at file line 90137.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected, so scan notices, library stamps and OCR errors remain as scanned.
Content note: The Maurist Latin of the letters. The Elenchus lists four classes: Class I letters written before Augustine was bishop (386-395), Class II letters from 396 to 410 "ante collationem Carthaginensem cum Donatistis habitam", Class III letters from 411 to 430, Class IV letters of uncertain date, and an Appendix of letters falsely ascribed to Augustine. Its numbering is the Maurist numbering, which is the numbering the NPNF English letters and most older translations use; the CSEL letters in cic/texts/augustine_epistulae-1-123-lat_goldbacher-csel34.txt, augustine_epistulae-124-184a-lat_goldbacher-csel44.txt and augustine_epistulae-critical_goldbacher-csel57-pars4.txt use a different order, so this file serves as the cross-reference between the two. Letters at the Maurist numbers CCLXVII and CCLXX have their headings at file lines 80110 and 80346. Migne's two-column page can interleave columns and notes in the OCR.
